rationale.overall: A and B are visually near-identical — same composition, palette, slab pose, curl, ground split and glow — and both sit the same distance from the REFERENCE's volumetric stone read, so neither take is better overall.
rationale.material: Both render the slab as a smooth gradient-shaded dark body with a flat translucent curl, missing the REFERENCE's gritty stone microtexture, soft contact shadow and light-transmitting ribbon equally.
rationale.silhouette: The slab, curl and diagonal ground edge occupy the same positions and proportions in both, with only sub-pixel differences at the slab's lower-left corner that do not favour either.
rationale.smallsize: At 128px, 32px and 16px both collapse to the same dark diagonal bar with an orange underline over a split light ground, holding the read equally well and losing the curl equally.
